frame.question: Why is my profit down this week?
frame.baseline: the average of the 4 weeks before

causes.title: A supplier raised the unit cost of a product

evidence.sql:
SELECT ROUND(-COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN x.period_cost > x.period_qty * x.base_cost
                                     THEN x.period_cost - x.period_qty * x.base_cost END), 0), 2) AS effect_ngn
FROM (SELECT q.product_id,
             SUM(CASE WHEN q.day BETWEEN DATE '2026-10-12' AND DATE '2026-10-18' THEN q.qty * c.unit_cost_ngn END) AS period_cost,
             SUM(CASE WHEN q.day BETWEEN DATE '2026-10-12' AND DATE '2026-10-18' THEN q.qty END) AS period_qty,
             ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN q.day IN (DATE '2026-09-14', DATE '2026-09-15', DATE '2026-09-16', DATE '2026-09-17', DATE '2026-09-18', DATE '2026-09-19', DATE '2026-09-20', DATE '2026-09-21', DATE '2026-09-22', DATE '2026-09-23', DATE '2026-09-24', DATE '2026-09-25', DATE '2026-09-26', DATE '2026-09-27', DATE '2026-09-28', DATE '2026-09-29', DATE '2026-09-30', DATE '2026-10-01', DATE '2026-10-02', DATE '2026-10-03', DATE '2026-10-04', DATE '2026-10-05', DATE '2026-10-06', DATE '2026-10-07', DATE '2026-10-08', DATE '2026-10-09', DATE '2026-10-10', DATE '2026-10-11') THEN q.qty * c.unit_cost_ngn END)
                   / SUM(CASE WHEN q.day IN (DATE '2026-09-14', DATE '2026-09-15', DATE '2026-09-16', DATE '2026-09-17', DATE '2026-09-18', DATE '2026-09-19', DATE '2026-09-20', DATE '2026-09-21', DATE '2026-09-22', DATE '2026-09-23', DATE '2026-09-24', DATE '2026-09-25', DATE '2026-09-26', DATE '2026-09-27', DATE '2026-09-28', DATE '2026-09-29', DATE '2026-09-30', DATE '2026-10-01', DATE '2026-10-02', DATE '2026-10-03', DATE '2026-10-04', DATE '2026-10-05', DATE '2026-10-06', DATE '2026-10-07', DATE '2026-10-08', DATE '2026-10-09', DATE '2026-10-10', DATE '2026-10-11') THEN q.qty END), 2) AS base_cost
      FROM (SELECT CAST(s.sold_at AS DATE) AS day, l.product_id, SUM(l.qty) AS qty
            FROM lightning.metastore.becuz.becuz.sale_lines l JOIN lightning.metastore.becuz.becuz.sales s ON s.sale_id = l.sale_id
            WHERE CAST(s.sold_at AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE '2026-10-12' AND DATE '2026-10-18' OR CAST(s.sold_at AS DATE) IN (DATE '2026-09-14', DATE '2026-09-15', DATE '2026-09-16', DATE '2026-09-17', DATE '2026-09-18', DATE '2026-09-19', DATE '2026-09-20', DATE '2026-09-21', DATE '2026-09-22', DATE '2026-09-23', DATE '2026-09-24', DATE '2026-09-25', DATE '2026-09-26', DATE '2026-09-27', DATE '2026-09-28', DATE '2026-09-29', DATE '2026-09-30', DATE '2026-10-01', DATE '2026-10-02', DATE '2026-10-03', DATE '2026-10-04', DATE '2026-10-05', DATE '2026-10-06', DATE '2026-10-07', DATE '2026-10-08', DATE '2026-10-09', DATE '2026-10-10', DATE '2026-10-11')
            GROUP BY CAST(s.sold_at AS DATE), l.product_id) q
      JOIN (SELECT p.product_id, p.invoice_date AS valid_from,
                   COALESCE(MIN(n.invoice_date), DATE '9999-12-31') AS valid_until, p.unit_cost_ngn
            FROM (SELECT product_id, invoice_date, AVG(unit_cost_ngn) AS unit_cost_ngn
                  FROM lightning.metastore.becuz.becuz.supplier_invoices GROUP BY product_id, invoice_date) p
            LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT product_id, invoice_date FROM lightning.metastore.becuz.becuz.supplier_invoices) n
              ON n.product_id = p.product_id AND n.invoice_date > p.invoice_date
            GROUP BY p.product_id, p.invoice_date, p.unit_cost_ngn) c
        ON c.product_id = q.product_id AND q.day >= c.valid_from AND q.day < c.valid_until
      GROUP BY q.product_id) x

causes.title: More stock expired or was damaged than usual

evidence.sql:
SELECT ROUND(-(COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN CAST(moved_at AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE '2026-10-12' AND DATE '2026-10-18' THEN qty * unit_cost_ngn END), 0)
                  - COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN CAST(moved_at AS DATE) IN (DATE '2026-09-14', DATE '2026-09-15', DATE '2026-09-16', DATE '2026-09-17', DATE '2026-09-18', DATE '2026-09-19', DATE '2026-09-20', DATE '2026-09-21', DATE '2026-09-22', DATE '2026-09-23', DATE '2026-09-24', DATE '2026-09-25', DATE '2026-09-26', DATE '2026-09-27', DATE '2026-09-28', DATE '2026-09-29', DATE '2026-09-30', DATE '2026-10-01', DATE '2026-10-02', DATE '2026-10-03', DATE '2026-10-04', DATE '2026-10-05', DATE '2026-10-06', DATE '2026-10-07', DATE '2026-10-08', DATE '2026-10-09', DATE '2026-10-10', DATE '2026-10-11') THEN qty * unit_cost_ngn END), 0) / 4), 2)
       AS effect_ngn
FROM lightning.metastore.becuz.becuz.stock_movements WHERE type IN ('expired', 'damaged')
evidence.summary: More stock expired or was damaged than usual: -25,152

check.note: The re-check matched: 25,152 naira from 21 records. The SQL re-check supports the claim that expired and damaged stock was higher than usual, cutting profit by 25,152 naira across 21 records, and the no-higher-than-usual test did not hold.

falsified_by.test: expired and damaged stock in the period is no higher than usual

causes.title: A discount kept running after the promo ended

evidence.sql:
SELECT ROUND(-COALESCE(SUM(l.discount_ngn), 0), 2) AS effect_ngn
FROM lightning.metastore.becuz.becuz.sale_lines l JOIN lightning.metastore.becuz.becuz.sales s ON s.sale_id = l.sale_id
JOIN lightning.metastore.becuz.becuz.promos p ON p.promo_id = l.promo_id
WHERE CAST(s.sold_at AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE '2026-10-12' AND DATE '2026-10-18' AND CAST(s.sold_at AS DATE) > p.end_date
evidence.summary: A discount kept running after the promo ended: -14,175

check.note: The re-check matched: 14,175 naira from 15 records. The SQL re-check confirms a promo discount kept running after the promo ended, reducing profit by 14,175 naira across 15 records, and the disproving test did not hold.

falsified_by.test: no promo discount was given after the promo's end date

cash_gaps.title: Transfers recorded at the till never reached the bank

evidence.sql:
SELECT ROUND(-COALESCE(SUM(net_ngn), 0), 2) AS effect_ngn FROM lightning.metastore.becuz.becuz.transfer_check
WHERE bank_txn_id IS NULL AND CAST(sold_at AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE '2026-10-12' AND DATE '2026-10-18'
evidence.summary: Transfers recorded at the till never reached the bank: -18,200

check.note: The re-check matched: 18,200 naira from 6 records. The SQL re-check supports that till-recorded transfers never reached the bank, with -18200.0 naira across 6 records, and the matching-bank-credit test did not hold.

falsified_by.test: every transfer sale in the period has a matching bank credit

memory.message: You confirmed that a supplier raised the unit cost of a product after an earlier run, so Becuz checked it first this time. It happened again in these 7 days.
You confirmed that transfers recorded at the till never reached the bank after an earlier run, so Becuz checked it first this time. It happened again in these 7 days.

ruled_out.reason: The records show no loss from this cause in this period.

ruled_out.hypothesis: The POS terminal charged a higher fee

summary.what_happened: Profit in these 7 days was ₦223,451, which is ₦83,273 less than usual (₦306,724).
why: A supplier raised the unit cost of a product. This cost you ₦45,408.
More stock expired or was damaged than usual. This cost you ₦25,152.
A discount kept running after the promo ended. This cost you ₦14,175.
cash: ₦18,200 from 6 transfer sales was recorded at the till but never reached the bank. The sales still count toward your profit, but this money is missing from your account.
summary.outcome: Without these 3 causes, these 7 days would have made about ₦308,186, against ₦306,724 usually, and chasing the 6 missing transfers brings ₦18,200 back into your account.

what_to_do.action: Compare prices from other suppliers for the affected product and review its shelf price.
Order perishables in smaller batches and check storage for the affected items.
Switch off the expired promo at the till and check which staff applied it.
Check these transfers against the bank app with the staff who recorded them.

owner_questions.question: 6 transfer sales in these 7 days have no matching payment in the bank (SL-10924, SL-10957, SL-11010, SL-11080, SL-11139, SL-11202). Can you check them with the staff who recorded them?

limitations: Findings show correlation, not proven causation.
Every number comes from SQL; the model only rates the evidence and words the notes.
